chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Nasr, from Abu Jameela, from Muhammad ibn Marwan, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)
Regarding the mute woman, how does her husband perform the cursing (li'an) with her? He (peace be upon him) said: They are separated, and she does not become permissible for him ever.

key_terms.الْخَرْسَاءِ: The mute woman (one who cannot speak)

ai.seo_question: How is the Islamic cursing procedure (li'an) performed when the wife is mute?
ai.summary: In this narration from al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies that for a mute wife, the husband performs the entire li'an procedure unilaterally since she cannot verbally reciprocate the oaths. This results in a permanent separation (talaq ba'in), distinguishing it from cases where verbal response might alter the legal nuances. The ruling underscores the practical adaptation of Quranic procedural requirements to physical limitations within Shia jurisprudence.
